blind.description: A thick, closed leatherbound fantasy tome or grimoire lying flat on the floor. It features a dark grey/black leather cover, brass or bronze corner brackets, two binding straps across the spine/cover, a circular metallic medallion in the center, a cream-colored block of parchment pages, and a small red ribbon bookmark extending from the page edge. Geometry is clean, solid, and fully continuous.
blind.from_above: A dark rectangular book cover oriented vertically, detailed with four metallic corner caps, two horizontal binding straps, a central round metallic plate, and a tiny red ribbon tail poking out from the right edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/20th the height of the figure (roughly 3 to 4 inches thick), and roughly 1/3 the width of the figure's diameter (about 1 foot long and 10 inches wide).

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
gemini note: slight cantilever on underside contact
